SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: Artificial Analysis says Muse Spark Open scores 39 on its Intelligence Index, making it the top US open-weights model it has measured.

SIGNALS.name: Google Antigravity
SIGNALS.summary: Google Antigravity is rolling out Gemini 4 Argon to paid Google AI Pro subscribers, with a separate weekly-only Argon quota for Pro.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says GPT-Live-1.1 improves voices and accents in ChatGPT Voice, Codex and dots, adding French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean and Japanese. API access is coming soon.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an open-weight model with 816B total and 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context, built for coding and agentic work.

SIGNALS.name: NVIDIA AI
SIGNALS.summary: NVIDIA published a write-up on how it built Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, and says the model is open with weights, data and recipes available on Hugging Face.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reported: CERN and Mistral AI signed a statement of intent on October 15 for a long-term partnership to build a Large Physics Model for scientific discovery.

SIGNALS.name: Bloomberg
SIGNALS.summary: Bloomberg reports Anthropic told prospective investors its third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion, as it moves ahead with plans to go public.

SIGNALS.name: Thariq
SIGNALS.summary: Thariq, who works on Claude Code, says Claude Code Desktop now understands its own capabilities better, such as spinning off subsessions, and calls it almost a v2.

SIGNALS.name: Inc42
SIGNALS.summary: Inc42 reports an agentic AI startup raised $2.5M in a seed round led by Accion Ventures to build AI relationship managers.
